title: Linocut
description: A moonlit sea with a small sailing boat, carved as a black lino print on cream paper. The cut lines spiral out from the moon and thicken in shadow; drag the moon across the sky and the whole block re-carves around it while the boat keeps riding the swell.
intent: One centre point composes the whole print: the moon is the light, the glitter path and the origin of every gouge, so moving it re-cuts the block instead of moving a sprite.
